name: KromiumDownloadItem
summary: Metadata representing a file download event from the browser engine.
declaration:
data class KromiumDownloadItem(
    val id: Int,
    val url: String,
    val suggestedFileName: String,
    val totalBytes: Long,
    val receivedBytes: Long,
    val percentComplete: Int,
    val speed: Long,
    val isInProgress: Boolean,
    val isComplete: Boolean,
    val isCanceled: Boolean,
    val isPaused: Boolean = false,
    val fullPath: String = ""
)

constructors.signature: KromiumDownloadItem(id: Int, url: String, suggestedFileName: String, totalBytes: Long, receivedBytes: Long, percentComplete: Int, speed: Long, isInProgress: Boolean, isComplete: Boolean, isCanceled: Boolean, isPaused: Boolean = false, fullPath: String = "")
constructors.description: Constructs a download item metadata instance.

parameters.name: suggestedFileName
parameters.description: Suggested filename for the download item.

parameters.name: totalBytes
parameters.description: Total size of the file in bytes, or -1 if unknown.

parameters.name: receivedBytes
parameters.description: Number of bytes received so far.

parameters.name: percentComplete
parameters.description: Download completion percentage (0-100), or -1 if indeterminate.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: Estimated transfer speed in bytes per second.

parameters.name: isInProgress
parameters.description: Whether the download is currently in progress.

parameters.name: isComplete
parameters.description: Whether the download has finished successfully.
